reason: Tests Playwright's internal glob compiler and URL matcher (`iso.globToRegexPattern` and `iso.urlMatches`) called directly, and their error text; Strider's Url.Pattern is a different grammar, with no matcher export to call. Strider's rejection of an invalid pattern is RO-155

Page.route takes a string pattern (Url.Pattern | string), so a RegExp URL, including one from another realm or with the g flag, has no form; a glob that matches the same requests would test something else
Playwright's it.skip runs this only on WebKit, where it intercepts a blob URL's fetch
